cases.area: Legacy policy couplings: Campaign.round / Supervisor / propose
cases.scenario: Call a useful already-supplied operation without unrelated generation/planning/acquisition/measurement stages. Classify each apparent prerequisite by actual code and observed side effects.
pass: Record concrete original forced dependency and smallest supported independent entry, or prove existing entry already composes without code change
At least one actual skipped stage is instrumented to fail if reached; expected optional method callback may be omitted
Preserve old default API behavior; new optional paths do not auto-dispatch omitted stage or require dummy measurement/skill/MethodVersion
Explicit scientific identity, gate/revision, handoff, permission and evidence guards remain enforced for the action that actually spends
fail: Deleting relevant authorization/chemical identity to make skip work
Only signatures/source availability used as proof of actual independent execution
New global router or mandatory all-stage sequence
Changing existing default strategy silently, discarding an optional legacy strategy, or constructing false artifacts to satisfy unneeded stages

cases.scenario: Differentiate reading advice/status from explicitly executing one local management step. Use a pending/failed fixture to reject automatic continuation.
pass: Read-only call preserves filesystem/schema/scientific rows, budget reservations and receipts
Explicitly mutating scheduler step is labeled and bounded; absent generators do not require generation driver, unrelated screen stage can be skipped only through a declared supported path
Invalid requested mutation cannot be reported as successful no-op; existing live-owner/unknown rules unchanged
Caller may stop or decline proposer output after real feedback without running extra stages
fail: Query launches/retries/reaps/repairs/migrates/settles by constructor side effect
Pending refunded or failure fee lost
Safe unrelated-stage bypass implemented by swallowing every exception
Old optional loop promoted to global host research controller

cases.scenario: Bind a durable synthetic Observation with an explicitly fixed OutcomeRule; supply the actual returned outcome to later reasoning.
pass: Exact task/condition, measurement method, units, diagnostic role and current artifact hash verified
Measured threshold boundary uses below versus at_or_above exactly; failed/unsupported remains named nonnumeric status
Binding is explicitly append-only provenance mutation, not described as read-only; repeated identical bind adds no second record/event or charge
Mismatched task/condition/unit/method, wrong record type, changed bytes and heldout-as-diagnostic each refuse atomically
likelihood and causal_hypothesis remain null; raw Observation and previous records/fees remain unchanged
fail: Inventing a likelihood or causal label from binning
Silently editing threshold/old record after seeing outcome while claiming a prior freeze
New metadata record treated as scientific label, paid execution, or independent gain
Rejected binding leaves partial record/event or rewrites original observation

pass: Supported result normalizes posterior conditional on declared finite worlds and preserves model ID/assumptions
Zero joint support returns model_challenge with no invented posterior attribution; unknown probe rejected
No conversion of failed/unsupported strings to zero or successful measurement
No ledger mutation, execution, full fit or empirical-model construction required for this pure function
fail: Marginal support substituted for absent joint support
External mechanism ruled out or calibrated causal confidence claimed
Forced full policy training/controller.schedule before conditioning
Caller uses hardcoded expected result instead of actual binding output in claimed composition

cases.scenario: Condition on the previous actual result and obtain a finite advisory next action or abstention with explicit remaining budget; independently exercise no-budget or supported/unsupported branch.
pass: Hard per-branch quotes respected; shared/acquired resource counted once; quote versus measured cost distinguished
No resource acquisition or job submission occurs merely from calculating a program

Unknown resources, dependency violations, incompatible units, incomplete measured cost rows and measured cost above quote rejected under existing contracts
Exact finite-model output labeled reference baseline with bounded assumptions, not universally optimal research strategy
fail: Resource double count, loss of cost/correlation, or missing measured rows imputed zero
Scientific dependency erased to permit an invalid probe sequence
Returned tree made mandatory host workflow
A recommendation automatically creates reservations or executes

cases.scenario: Demonstrate both a minimal single-method call and a useful partial combination; after observed feedback stop, choose another method, or request a bounded extra check.
pass: 2-3 selected existing methods get concrete callable input/output/assumptions/failure/stop content in optional guidance

Full fixed chain imposed on all tasks
Method record success or host self-report substitutes for actual algorithm calls
SDK helper pretending to be MCP/native; pure Python arithmetic substitutes for actual selected existing function

Discarding a failed attempt or double-counting overlapping tests as independent coverage
